g.text: Solid arrow: reference Dashed arrow: dependency Filled diamond: ownership Hollow triangle: interface
All 15 top-level core types are shown, plus GameConfig.PlayerConfig.
Enum-typed fields carry type dependencies without extra arrows.
GameEngine also refers to topCard (1), drawnCard (0..1) and gameWinner (0..1).
These are aliases to existing cards/players, not additional owned objects.
